query: Lint MD-1234 and tell me whether it is ready to start.
expected_behavior: Runs the deterministic rubric-lint command against the named ticket
Reports the canonical Scout verdict verbatim and separates blocking, section, and recommended gaps
Treats a missing or placeholder Intent marker as advisory without lowering an otherwise actionable verdict
Names what is already present and suggests source discovery plus enrichment only when the ticket is thin
Does not edit the Jira ticket
